subject: Fwd: GPS Data
body:
Hello Taryn and Patrick,

First of all, very sorry for my delayed reply on this. Setting this up required a lit bit of work, and I never got to it to pass it to my team. Right now I moved the question to our support, and they will be able to help.

Here is what should be done. We are currently storing the data in a database that is not best for querying and visualization (Cassandra). Ideally we should give Taryn access to an Elasticsearch instance, with Kibana user interface, so she can both explore the data, and query it as needed. So the following items had to be done:

1. Setting up a dedicated Elasticsearch/kibana instance [DONE]
2. Writing a code to move data from our Cassandra internal database to the Elastic/Kibana [WIP, ETA Wed. 16th]
3. Running the script to move all the data to the Elastic/Kibana [To Do, ETA Oct. 23rd. This is the time it takes to move all the data].
4. Ensure your team has proper access to the database.

We will setup a private account for every user who wants to access the data. This way we can have detailed audit as well, in case necessary. We will set up access for Taryn, but if anyone else also wants username/password, please let us know.

Also, we would need to know what IP addresses should be whitelisted to access the data. Taryn, would you mind sharing the public IP that you expect to use to access the data?

Thanks,
Mohammad

--
Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data)
